name: zinc finger translocation associated

function.text: ZFTA encodes zinc finger translocation-associated protein. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Ependymoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
